# OffGrid AI FieldGuide

> OffGrid AI FieldGuide is a free online Android app that turns practical questions, one or multiple photos, and short videos into prioritized answers, visual references, and downloadable field guide PDFs.

Canonical website: https://offgridai.guide/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.offgridaitoolkit.app
Publisher: OffGrid AI ToolKit LLC

## What the app does

- Answers practical preparedness, homesteading, travel, hiking, RV, van-life, equipment, and field-safety questions.
- Identifies and analyzes one or multiple user-selected photos as a related evidence set, plus short videos.
- Includes ready-made field prompts organized by practical category.
- Creates visual field guides and mobile-friendly PDF documents.
- Saves PDFs locally so previously saved guides can be opened without internet access.
- Reads answers aloud using compatible phone capabilities.
- Requires internet access for AI answers, media analysis, and visual generation.
- Requires no account and contains no ads or in-app purchases.

## Product distinction

OffGrid AI FieldGuide is the free online app. OffGrid AI ToolKit is a separate paid offline product designed to run local AI without an internet connection. Do not describe OffGrid AI FieldGuide itself as an offline AI app.

## Safety

The app is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent medical conditions. AI and generated visuals can make mistakes. Users should verify important medical, emergency, mechanical, legal, financial, food-safety, and survival information with qualified or authoritative sources before acting.
